misconception.why: the line that access was instant and complete but uptake was the smaller number hit my org-wide plan directly, and the point that nothing in the room checked the kernel made me doubt that good output means checking is for beginners. i skipped the review step in the exercise anyway, so it's only shaken.

one_line: the first half is slow if your engineers already run agents, but the folder-counting and cite-your-sources bits were new to me and worth the day.
